- **Cross-session behavior on active sessions.** The one-time seed→live migration fires on the FIRST invocation of any Python writer after this lands. Two concurrent /issue sessions that both hit the resolver at the same instant WILL race for the migration `flock`; the loser sees the live file already exist and skips. - **The shell helper's `--path-format=absolute` flag was added.** Older git (<2.31) does not honor it; the resolver falls back to relative + resolves against `SCRIPT_DIR`. If any consumer runs on an ancient git the CI does not exercise, the flag would silently degrade — but the case block already re-anchors via `SCRIPT_DIR`, so behavior is preserved.
- **`workflow_lint.py` invocation slowness.** Running it in an idle worktree took >90s; two of its checks hit the network / snapshot the whole tree. Not fixed here, but worth flagging for the reviewer if they see a slow gate.
